root_cause.escaped_defect: Independent pull_request workflows and fetch-depth:0 caused duplicated runners, full remote-ref fetches, stale PR pressure, and occasional missing canonical Required runs.
root_cause.evidence: PR #3911 started browser, page/SEO, quality and skill workflows despite Required already owning website release classification; Required and Skill Projection logs fetched refs/heads/*.

prevention.ingress: Heavy browser, page/SEO, Quality Intelligence and Skill Projection no longer allocate independent PR runners; Required remains the canonical PR gate.
prevention.fetch: Required and website classifiers use shallow checkout plus an exact comparison-base fetch on demand.
prevention.provider: Supabase Preview applicability is owned by the Required aggregate; the redundant standalone runner is retired.
prevention.recovery: A five-minute watchdog redispatches Required only when a recent open PR has no canonical run after 90 seconds.
prevention.hygiene: A bounded janitor closes explicitly superseded PRs and generated candidates stale for more than 30 days.

evidence.observed_failure: multiple independent PR workflows plus full-history checkout and at least 100 open PRs
evidence.proof_boundary: canonical Required gate, exact base/head comparison, bounded recovery and cleanup
